about_the_game:
Gothic Hell: Survivors throws you into fast-paced gothic chaos where survival is earned through spellcraft, reflexes, and smart build choices. Fight through short, intense runs filled with relentless swarms, evolving magic, and rich upgrades that shape each attempt.

Master auto-cast spells and reactive movement while unlocking new powers, characters, and passive boosts. Explore layered 3D arenas with vertical challenges, hidden secrets, and dynamic events that make every battle feel fresh and alive.

Choose a survivor, build your power, and dive into an atmospheric bullet hell experience that rewards creativity, adaptability, and momentum. No two runs play the same, and each one brings you closer to mastering the madness.

Key Features
• Fast-paced bullet hell ARPG with auto-cast spells
• Unique survivors with game-changing abilities
• Vertical 3D arenas packed with secrets and shifting layouts
• Deep synergy systems and meta progression between runs
• Procedural encounters blended with handcrafted visuals
• Designed for high replayability and quick-hit sessions
• Gothic horror world with stylized art and haunting sound

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD RX 570 (4GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for faster load times

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
